guidance_introduction: This is a user application created with HoHu CLI. The project name, selected components and actual source revisions are recorded in [.hohu/project.json](.hohu/project.json). Read this entry point and the instructions for each affected component before editing. Inspect the current checkout when guidance and code disagree, and explain unresolved conflicts.
guidance_skills:
Before implementation, check the Skills available in the coding assistant. Prefer the following workflows when installed and applicable:

- `hohu-project`: create, initialize, start or troubleshoot a HoHu project.
- `hohu-business-module`: build or extend a business module involving data models, APIs, permissions, pages or application AI tools.
- For small text, style or local fixes, work directly from project conventions; a full module workflow is optional.

Locate the selected Skill through the assistant's available Skills, read its actual `SKILL.md`, and check its scope and component compatibility before following the workflow. When a task combines project preparation and business development, use `hohu-project` first, then `hohu-business-module` for the feature work.

If a Skill is missing, explain this and provide `hohu skills install` as the installation entry point. Continue work that can be completed under project conventions without claiming to have invoked the missing Skill. If a Skill is incompatible with the installed components, explain the mismatch and use the applicable project rules. User requirements and project instructions take precedence over Skill guidance.
guidance_role_backend: Backend APIs, services, permissions and data models.
guidance_role_frontend: Web pages, API clients, types and application state.
guidance_role_app: Mobile application, platform-specific pages and API integration.
guidance_no_documents: No standard instruction or README file was found. Inspect this component's source and configuration before choosing commands or conventions.
guidance_workflow:
1. Identify affected components from the map above. Read their applicable Agent files and only the documentation relevant to the task. Discover additional instructions near the files being changed.
2. Verify commands and dependencies against the checked-out README, package configuration and scripts; run component commands from that component's directory. Custom repositories may differ from official HoHu layouts.
3. For a feature, refactor or contract change, agree on scope and acceptance criteria and save a design before implementation. Follow the project's documented design location; if none is defined, use `.local/docs/specs/`. Keep draft decisions and test reports separate from current-behavior documentation.
4. When an API, permission, field or state changes, check its producer and installed consumers together. Verify request/response formats, identifier handling and authentication against current source and API definitions. State any missing component that prevents end-to-end verification.
5. Preserve tenant and authorization boundaries, follow the component's transaction and layering rules, and reuse existing UI and request patterns. Add meaningful regression tests for behavior changes and run the affected checks.
6. Preserve existing edits and credentials. Report changed behavior, actual verification and remaining gaps; update relevant documentation. Use the user's team conventions for commits and collaboration.
guidance_artifacts: Keep temporary files under `.local/`: `docs/` for drafts, `tests/` for test roots, `cache/` for caches, `reports/` for verification and `private/` for local credentials. Configure tools with explicit output paths. Keep these files out of version control and confirm ignore rules in every affected Git repository. Root ignore rules do not configure independent component repositories. Use an appropriate shared, access-controlled location for long-lived team decisions.
guidance_claude: Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the shared project instructions, then read the applicable instructions inside each affected component. Maintain shared rules in AGENTS.md so these entry points remain consistent.
guidance_readme_introduction: This workspace contains the components selected during project creation. See [.hohu/project.json](.hohu/project.json) for the project name, repository revisions and the bundled guidance version. Component repositories retain their own source history.
guidance_startup:
Read the selected components' setup instructions and prepare their environment configuration and required services. From this directory, run:

```sh
hohu init
hohu dev
```

Creation has not installed dependencies or initialized services. `hohu init` installs and initializes selected components; when a backend is present it can execute database migrations and seed data. Verify the target environment first. `hohu dev` remains in the foreground. Check actual service health after startup.
guidance_ai:
Open this workspace root in your coding assistant and start with [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) points to the same shared rules. If you open a component separately, explicitly provide the workspace AGENTS.md as context; instructions outside its Git root may not be discovered automatically.

Optional HoHu workflows are available through `hohu skills install`; follow the installer requirements and scope prompts. Skills complement the local instructions. You can customize the generated files for your application and team. Creating a project does not configure automatic guidance updates. If the root files are not covered by a repository, arrange version control or shared storage for team changes; commits inside a component do not include parent files.
